cleared.check: Long MULMOD sequences inside one frame with the modulus repeating, alternating between two or three full-width values, alternating 2^256-1 with denominators as FullMath.mulDiv does (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24 and :48, and :112 for mulDivRoundingUp), switching between full-width and narrow moduli, changing in a single bit of one limb from one instruction to the next, with a STATICCALL child frame that runs other moduli between two parent MULMODs, mulmod(m-1, m-1, m), and operands that meet the ruint 1.21.0 fault shape. This is the sequence set the cycle 25 critic asked for, for interpreters that keep state across instructions (bor's memo).
cleared.result: 20,000 records of seed 2026112601, five words each (100,000 words), sent in 67 eth_calls of 300 records per endpoint with web3_clientVersion before and after each call. Every word equals Python integer arithmetic on QuikNode Polygon (many qn-* v2.11.1 backends), polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com (all five private builds, 8 to 16 batches each), polygon.drpc.org, bsc-dataseed1 (both builds), 48 Club (both builds), reth-bsc on publicnode and api.avax.network. The harness was checked on the reference interpreter (0 differences on 600 records), and two planted memo faults that key the reciprocal on one limb would change 4,467 and 2,941 words of the set, so the set can see a stale reciprocal. No public endpoint is known to run the memo code, so on Polygon this checks the private builds and the tagged release; the memo itself is cleared by source below.

cleared.check: Lead L-1076 by source on develop: is the MULMOD memo active by default, where does it live, and can two workers or two frames share it.
cleared.result: The memo is a field of the EVM struct (core/vm/evm.go line 219) and opMulmod always uses it (instructions.go lines 200-204); there is no flag. It is per EVM instance: the serial processor reuses one EVM for a block, and every BlockSTM V2 incarnation builds a new EVM (core/parallel_state_processor.go line 628). Within one EVM the memo keys on all four limbs (mulmod_memo.go lines 55-66), copies the modulus before the in-place write, and uint256 v1.3.2 MulModWithReciprocal and MulMod run the same umul and reduce4 (cleared in cycles 12, 17 and 24). Consecutive moduli alternating between 2^256-1 and a denominator only cause misses. The release that will carry Salvador is not tagged, so this reads develop; v2.11.0 to v2.11.2 have no memo.

cleared.check: Lead L-1101: is bor's V1 StateDB parallel path (GetStateAndCommittedState without MVRead, core/state/statedb.go line 1162) reachable on mainnet.
cleared.result: No. At v2.11.2 block import constructs only NewV2StateProcessor (core/blockchain.go line 975) and the serial processor, and runs them side by side (lines 1309-1420). NewParallelStateProcessor, which is the only place that calls SetMVHashmap (core/parallel_state_processor.go lines 66, 130, 226), has no caller in core/blockchain.go, eth/backend.go (lines 458-460) or miner/worker.go. Blocks are built serially. Stale gas inputs on V1 therefore cannot reach a block, and a V2 result is checked against the header in any case.

cleared.check: CLZ (EIP-7939), active on Polygon since Lisovo (mainnet LisovoBlock 83,756,500, bor params/config.go) and through Chicago (block 87,218,600, which adds PIP-88 cold storage repricing): does the PoolManager runtime execute byte 0x1e, which changed from INVALID to CLZ.
cleared.result: No. A scan of the 24,009 byte runtime of research/network-risk/build/PoolManager.json that skips push data finds no 0x1e at an instruction boundary, so no PoolManager path changed meaning at Lisovo. PIP-88 changes gas only, and no line of src/ reads gas except to forward it (src/libraries/Hooks.sol, src/types/Currency.sol).

cleared.check: Lead L-1097, the failed Avalanche transaction 0x52cea783...c269 (block 101,395,505, index 119, to 0x6a000f20005980200259b80c5102003040001068, selector 0xe3ead59e): does the PoolManager decide it differently from the source.
cleared.result: Partly answered. An eth_call of the same sender, calldata and gas at block 101,395,504 succeeds and returns a word, and at block 101,395,505 (after the whole block) it reverts with 0xcea9e31d, which is not the selector of any of the 47 errors declared in src/ (types mapped to their ABI form). The PoolManager wraps hook and token reverts in its own selectors and passes callback reverts through, so this revert most likely comes from the router's own check after earlier transactions of the block moved the price. A trace is still needed to prove which frame reverted.
